notes.title: Minor Update
notes.content:
Howdy from Unknown Studio, 

We've taken notice of some feedback about Hexily's aggressiveness and are toning it down. We are making this change to hopefully reduce any frustration that players might have with dealing with her.

As for new content, the team is currently not planning any additional content for the foreseeable future. 

The team will be keeping up with Memento to make sure it is available to play in a stable state.

We hope you all enjoy Memento and thank you for playing.
